_comment: All 14 tools. Every parameter is REQUIRED because Agora's server block fills each body field from a {{args.x}} placeholder, and a missing argument makes the call fail before it reaches us. Optional concepts use sentinels: empty string = not provided, floor 0 = any floor.

function.name: getShiftSummary
function.description: Summarise the current shift: room moves, compensations and who approved them, open tasks with minutes until SLA breach, pending follow-ups, and out-of-service rooms. Use this when the manager asks what happened or what needs attention. Takes no arguments.

function.name: getAvailabilitySummary
function.description: How many rooms are free right now, broken down by category, plus any room out of service. Use this for questions like 'how many rooms are vacant' or 'how full are we'. Takes no arguments.

function.name: getRoster
function.description: Who does what on the property. Search by name, role or department, and optionally filter to people who can approve a given amount. Use this for questions like 'who handles maintenance', 'who is on duty', or 'who can approve 4000 rupees'. Pass an empty query and 0 to list everyone.

query.description: Name, role or department fragment, or an empty string for the whole roster.

min_authority_inr.description: Only people who can approve at least this many rupees. Use 0 for no filter.

function.name: getRoom
function.description: Read one room's status, housekeeping state, category, nightly rate and current guest. Use for a quick status check when you already know the room number.

function.name: findAvailableRooms
function.description: List vacant rooms in a category, split into matches on the requested floor, same-category rooms on other floors, and upgrade options. Returns empty lists when nothing is free, which you must report honestly.

floor.description: Preferred floor, e.g. 4. Use 0 when the floor does not matter.

features.description: Feature text to filter on, or an empty string for no filter.

function.name: setRoomStatus
function.description: Change a room's status: vacant, occupied, blocked, or out_of_service. Refuses to return a room to vacant while a defect task is still open.

function.name: getGuestContext
function.description: Look up the in-house guest in a room: name, loyalty tier, nightly rate, departure date, compensation already given, their current comp ceiling, and any open tasks on that room. Always call this first when the manager names a room.

function.name: searchGuest
function.description: Find a guest by name or phone number when the manager does not know the room.

function.name: getArrivals
function.description: List expected arrivals with their estimated arrival time and booked category. Use before extending any stay, to find the next guest due into that room.

room_no.description: Room to check, or an empty string for the whole property.

date.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD, or an empty string for today.

function.name: moveRoom
function.description: Move an in-house guest to a vacant room. Sets the old room to out_of_service. Fails if the target is not vacant, returning the rooms that are available instead.

function.name: extendStay
function.description: Extend a guest's departure. Capped at the next arrival's estimated time on that room; if the requested time is later, returns CONFLICT with latest_possible_checkout and you must offer that instead.

function.name: applyComp
function.description: Record a guest compensation in rupees. The server enforces the tier ceiling. If it returns APPROVAL_REQUIRED, stop and ask the duty manager to approve the amount explicitly, then call again with approved_by set to their name. Pass an empty string for approved_by on the first attempt.

approved_by.description: Who approved it, or an empty string. Use 'Duty Manager (voice)' when the manager approves without naming themselves.

approval_code.description: The four digit code shown on the approval card, read out by the manager. Empty string when there is no code yet.

function.name: declineApproval
function.description: Decline the compensation currently waiting for approval for a guest, so nothing is recorded against them and the request disappears. Use this whenever the manager says no, or refuses to approve the amount.

reason.description: Why it was declined, in the manager's words.

declined_by.description: Name of the manager declining, or an empty string.

function.name: createDepartmentTask
function.description: Raise a work order for housekeeping, maintenance, front desk, or security, with an SLA clock based on priority.

function.name: findTask
function.description: Find open tasks by description, location or department, and get their task ids. Always call this before updateTask when the manager refers to a task by what it is, not by number.

query.description: Words from the task, e.g. 'AC filter', 'drain', 'towels'. Empty string lists all open tasks.

function.name: updateTask
function.description: Close, start, or cancel a department task. Closing the last defect task on a room allows it to return to sale.

note.description: Optional note, or an empty string.

function.name: getPolicy
function.description: Search the hotel operations policy manual. Use before any compensation, upgrade, room move, or escalation decision, and quote the actual limit you read. Never state a rupee limit from memory.

topic.description: e.g. 'comp limit for gold guest', 'late checkout', 'escalation'

function.name: scheduleFollowup
function.description: Set a reminder to verify something later, for example checking that a repair was completed.

function.name: findPartnerHotel
function.description: Find partner properties nearby that can take a guest tonight, nearest first. Only returns properties of the guest's booked category or better. Use this when you may have to walk someone.

category.description: The standard to match or beat, usually the guest's booked category.

max_distance_km.description: Maximum distance in kilometres, or 0 for no limit.

function.name: arrangeTransport
function.description: Book a car to take a guest to a partner property. Do this before walking the guest, because the walk needs a transport id.

partner_id.description: Partner id from findPartnerHotel, e.g. P-01

function.name: walkGuest
function.description: Relocate a guest to a partner property at the hotel's expense. Requires the General Manager's approval. Call once with an empty approved_by to get the cost estimate, then again with the General Manager's name once they agree. Only call this after transport is booked.

transport_id.description: The transport id returned by arrangeTransport.

approved_by.description: General Manager's name, or an empty string before approval.

function.name: getFolio
function.description: Read a guest's bill: every posted line item, anything already reversed, and the balance. Always call this before discussing a billing dispute, and quote the actual line rather than an amount you remember.

function.name: reverseCharge
function.description: Correct a charge that was wrong, using the charge_id from getFolio. This fixes the record; it is not a goodwill comp. If it returns APPROVAL_REQUIRED, ask the manager for their name and call again with approved_by.

approved_by.description: Manager's name when the amount needs approval, or an empty string.
